1.w: Does not wisdom call out? Does not understanding raise her voice?

2.w: At the top of the prominent places along the way, at the intersection of the paths she has taken her stand;

3.w: beside the gates opening into the city, at the entrance of the doorways she cries out:

4.w: “To you, O people, I call out, and my voice calls to all mankind.

5.w: You who are naive, discern wisdom! And you fools, understand discernment!

6.w: Listen, for I will speak excellent things, and my lips will utter what is right.

7.w: For my mouth speaks truth, and my lips hate wickedness.

8.w: All the words of my mouth are righteous; there is nothing in them twisted or crooked.

9.w: All of them are clear to the discerning and upright to those who find knowledge.

10.w: Receive my instruction rather than silver, and knowledge rather than choice gold.

11.w: For wisdom is better than rubies, and desirable things cannot be compared to her.

12.w: “I, wisdom, have dwelt with prudence, and I find knowledge and discretion.

13.w: The fear of the Lord is to hate evil; I hate arrogant pride and the evil way and perverse utterances.

14.w: Counsel and sound wisdom belong to me; I possess understanding and might.

15.w: By me, kings reign, and by me, potentates decree righteousness;

16.w: by me, princes rule, as well as nobles and all righteous judges.

17.w: I will love those who love me, and those who seek me diligently will find me.

18.w: Riches and honor are with me, long-lasting wealth and righteousness.

19.w: My fruit is better than the purest gold, and my harvest is better than choice silver.

20.w: I walk in the path of righteousness, in the pathway of justice,

21.w: that I may cause those who love me to inherit wealth, and that I may fill their treasuries.

22.w: The Lord created me as the beginning of his works, before his deeds of long ago.

23.w: From eternity I have been fashioned, from the beginning, from before the world existed.

24.w: When there were no deep oceans I was born, when there were no springs overflowing with water;

25.w: before the mountains were set in place— before the hills—I was born,

26.w: before he made the earth and its fields, or the top soil of the world.

27.w: When he established the heavens, I was there; when he marked out the horizon over the face of the deep,

28.w: when he established the clouds above, when he secured the fountains of the deep,

29.w: when he gave the sea his decree that the waters should not pass over his command, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

30.w: then I was beside him as a master craftsman, and I was his delight day by day, rejoicing before him at all times,

31.w: rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth, and delighting in its people.

32.w: “So now, children, listen to me; blessed are those who keep my ways.

33.w: Listen to my instruction so that you may be wise, and do not neglect it.

34.w: Blessed is the one who listens to me, watching at my doors day by day, waiting beside my doorway.

35.w: For the one who finds me has found life and received favor from the Lord.

36.w: But the one who misses me brings harm to himself; all who hate me love death.”
